---
name: Refactoring Request
about: Suggest code refactoring or architectural improvements
title: '[REFACTOR] '
labels: refactoring, enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Current State

Describe the current code or architecture that needs refactoring.

## Problem

What problems does the current implementation cause? (e.g., maintainability, performance, readability)

## Proposed Solution

Describe the refactoring approach you suggest.

## Benefits

- [ ] Improved readability
- [ ] Better testability
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Reduced complexity
- [ ] Better separation of concerns
- [ ] Easier maintenance

## Impact

- [ ] API changes (breaking)
- [ ] API changes (non-breaking)
- [ ] Database schema changes
- [ ] Test changes
- [ ] Documentation updates

## Risk Assessment

- **Risk Level**: Low / Medium / High
- **Affected Areas**: List affected modules/files
- **Rollback Plan**: Describe how to revert if issues arise

## Additional Context

Any code examples, diagrams, or references.
